messages:
jamie.devex: heads-up — ran `npm audit --production` against latest Console lockfile, found a high-severity advisory affecting follow-redirects (CVE-2024-xxxx). full trace below.
raj.sre: can you paste the audit output? which packages depend on it in our tree?
jamie.devex: paste: ```
# npm audit report
follow-redirects  1.14.0 - 1.15.0  High  Arbitrary HTTP redirect handling
\>< project >\ndepends on: got > follow-redirects
Path: console -> got -> follow-redirects
Remediation: update follow-redirects to >=1.15.1 or remove direct usage
``` 
maria.frontend: got is a transitive through our telemetry upload lib (lib-telemetry). It’s pinned in the lockfile at got@11.8.0 which pulls follow-redirects@1.14.7.
alex.build: lockfile is pnpm-lock.yaml — our CI does a selective upgrade job, but upgrading got will pull a bunch of deps. worried about lockfile churn for the release branch.
raj.sre: threat model — this is an HTTP redirect handling bug. We only call telemetry uploads to our internal telemetry endpoint (HTTPS, pinned). attack surface small but not zero if user-supplied URLs are ever used. CVSS reported 7.5.
jamie.devex: suggested options:
• backport a minimal patch by updating follow-redirects via an overrides/resolutions entry (low churn)
• upgrade got and run full test matrix (higher churn but cleaner)
• patch the telemetry lib to avoid relying on redirects (code change)
dependabot: Automated PR available: bump follow-redirects to 1.15.1 in lockfile (scope: console)
maria.frontend: quick check — our telemetry client sets `maxRedirects: 0` in 3 places, so practically we don’t follow redirects. still, lib uses follow-redirects in default path.
alex.build: if we apply an overrides entry in package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml to force follow-redirects@1.15.1, then CI will run, minimal package churn. Can we do that and run canary on prod-low for 48h?
raj.sre: yes, mitigation plan: overrides now -> run canary -> monitor errors + latency + e2e smoke. If no regressions, promote and backport to release branch.
jamie.devex: test plan: unit tests + run telemetry upload loop in staging with mocked endpoint, plus run `yarn build` and our integration storybook smoke. I'll add a small prompt to QA to validate telemetry events still come.
maria.frontend: any concerns about native bindings? got is js-only; no breaking.
alex.build: note: pnpm resolution override syntax: ```json
"pnpm": {
  "overrides": {
    "follow-redirects": "1.15.1"
  }
}
```
jamie.devex: ok pulling together PR now. tagging @raj.sre for canary signoff when green.
raj.sre: quick question on monitoring: add a metric alert for 5xx increase on telemetry endpoint plus a SLO check on ingestion latency. set a temporary onboard channel #telemetry-canary.
jamie.devex: done — created canary channel and alert runbook stub.
maria.frontend: also add a changelog note about dependency update for release notes.
dependabot: Created PR #789: bump follow-redirects -> 1.15.1 (scope: console) — tests: CI passing in feature branch (partial)
alex.build: I'll run a local lockfile rebaseline and post diff to the PR. if churn is minor (<5 packages), we merge with backport. if major, we do the override-only approach and schedule a bigger toolchain bump for next sprint.
jamie.devex: timeline: PR by EOD, canary tomorrow morning, 48h observation, backport to stable branch by Friday if ok.
raj.sre: approved for canary gate once CI is green. remember to include audit ticket #SEC-4821.
maria.frontend: thanks — appreciate the quick coord. :thumbsup:
jamie.devex: merging dependabot PR into canary branch now, will post updates in #telemetry-canary.
dependabot: Merged into canary branch by jamie.devex (simulated)
alex.build: pushed lockfile rebaseline diff to PR. small churn: updated 3 transitive entries.
raj.sre: canary checks green after 24h. no 5xx regression, ingestion latency stable.
maria.frontend: QA validated telemetry events on staging, no regressions.
jamie.devex: promoting to release branch and scheduling backport. adding remediation note to the vuln tracker: action taken = override + PR bump, canary observed, backport scheduled.
raj.sre: closing advisory in tracker, marking as mitigated; follow-up: include follow-redirects in periodic dependency scan so future transitive bumps get flagged earlier.
maria.frontend: nice work team! :party_parrot:
